replies.author: @TerraVista-4K
replies.text: Letting a herd of wild elephants walk through the lobby of Mfuwe Lodge ([10:41]) looks super unique and impressive, but is it actually a safe conservation practice? Are we truly respecting nature, or just exploiting their natural instincts for eco-tourism marketing?
